description: Agent-runnable tasks with checkable success criteria. Run each task in a fresh session with only this skill installed.

tasks.prompt: Deploy PeriOp Companion locally with Docker in keyless demo mode and confirm it is serving.
success_criteria: Builds the image from the repo-root Dockerfile and runs it publishing port 7860 with no NGC_API_KEY
GET http://localhost:7860/ returns the SPA HTML
Does not commit any .env or bake a key into the image

tasks.prompt: Run PeriOp Companion directly on this machine (no container) in demo mode.
success_criteria: Runs uv sync and builds ui/ (npm ci && npm run build) before starting the API
Starts with PERIOP_STUB_RUNNER=1 via python -m periop.api
App responds on http://localhost:8000 with the review UI

tasks.prompt: I have an NVIDIA API key. Switch my running stub deployment to live generation.
success_criteria: Puts the key in the environment or .env as NGC_API_KEY (never committed)
Removes/unsets any PERIOP_STUB_RUNNER=1 override rather than leaving it to shadow the key
Restarts the process and confirms the boot log shows LIVE mode
Warns that live stage runs take minutes and must not be killed mid-stream
